# Higgsfield AI Creator Partnership Program

Join a community of the most ambitious AI creators

## Home to the creators shaping visual storytelling

A full Higgsfield plan renewed every month, credit support, tips and hands-on help growing your audience, and a direct line to Higgsfield.

## Everything you need to go further

### Create without limits

- Full Higgsfield plan, renewed every month
- Extra credits for films and series
- New models and features before public release

### Grow and get noticed

- Affiliate program to earn from your reach
- Your work featured across Higgsfield channels
- Playbooks and hands-on advice from the team

### Never create alone

- A dedicated Higgsfield contact, anytime
- Curated partner community across 35+ countries
- Challenges, spotlights and collabs

Made by partners. A rolling selection of work from inside the program

Apply now

## Backed by a platform 40 million creators trust

Here's what the partners inside the program say about it.

[The Higgsfield AI Creator Partnership Program](https://higgsfield.ai/blog/creator-partnership-program) is how Higgsfield backs the creators who are pushing AI content forward.

Higgsfield is a full creative suite for making AI video, images, and audio, with tools like Cinema Studio, Soul, and Marketing Studio. A lot of creators build their work on it. The CPP is the structure we've built around our relationships with the best of them.

The point of the program is simple: give serious creators the resources, access, and support to do their best work without hitting walls, and bring them together into one strong community.

Anyone creating with AI.

That includes filmmakers, cinematographers, designers, editors, animators, tutorial makers, and social creators.

Platform doesn't matter. YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, and cross-platform creators are all welcome. What matters is that AI content is genuinely central to what you make, not a side experiment.

We work with both sides of the range: creators building their first audience, and industry veterans bringing decades of experience into AI.

Applying is simple:

1. Fill out the application form on our site.
2. A real person on our team reviews every application.
3. There's no automated filter sorting people by follower count.
4. Everyone gets a response by email, whether it's a yes or a no.
5. If you're accepted, that email includes your next steps to get set up.

How long the review takes depends on how many applications we're going through at the time. Either way, you'll hear back.

Six things, from day one:

1. A plan and credits, every month. A full Higgsfield plan that renews each month, plus extra credits for bigger projects, films, and series. You make the ambitious version of your idea, not the cut-down one.
2. Growth support. Real, hands-on advice from our team on growing your audience and sharpening your content. Tips and playbooks tailored to what you make.
3. A direct line to the team. Talk directly with the Higgsfield team whenever you need to, for credits, questions, or feedback.
4. Early access. New models and features reach partners before they go public, plus exclusive offers.
5. An exclusive community. A curated community of partners across 35+ countries, sharing what works and collaborating.
6. Getting featured. Partner work gets featured across Higgsfield's channels and the creator hub, extra reach on top of your own.

We ask you to tag or mention Higgsfield when the tools are part of your work, and stay actively engaged with our launches when they're relevant to what you're making. Beyond that, you have full creative freedom. You keep full ownership of your work and your voice.

The community is the heart of the program, and it's built to stay focused and useful.

It's a curated space for a group of creators who take AI content seriously and are happy to share what's actually working, swap strategies, and collaborate when there's a real reason to.

On top of the day-to-day, we run challenges, creator spotlights, and sessions where partners can learn from each other.

The biggest thing partners tell us is that they're not doing this alone anymore. The credits and tools matter, but it's the support and the people around them that tie it all together.

Yes. The Higgsfield AI Creator Partnership Program is our take on a creative partner program. We say Creator because Higgsfield is a full creative suite, and the program is for everyone building with it.

CPP is our partnership program with a plan, credits, early access, and community. The Earn program at [higgsfield.ai](https://higgsfield.ai/) runs paid campaigns open to creators of any size, a good place to start if you want to work with us before applying to CPP. The two also work together: as a CPP partner, you can receive your own individual Earn campaigns on top of everything the program already gives you.
